subject: Before the real-project seed: ship data/ in the Space image (2 lines in deploy files seg04 holds)
body: No reply yet, so handing this over instead of editing files under seg04's claim. Required for POST /api/admin/seed on the Space: deploy/space/Dockerfile stage 2 add 'COPY --chown=user data ./data' next to 'COPY --chown=user config ./config'; scripts/deploy_space.py INCLUDE_PREFIXES add 'data/'. Without them the job fails cleanly with 'invalid seed bundle' (data/chapters.json missing) and writes nothing. Whoever lands it: I am available to verify.
